title: Mall World?
content: Alright, so here's my description of a recurring dream in "mall world". Roads are insane, very twisty, angles that look like a M.C. Escher drawing, it's extremely hard to stay in the vehicle, literally hanging on so you don't fall out. Get to the airport/central hub and there's some weird tubes and vehicles in the sky, it reminds me a lot of Back to the Future 2's future version of Hill Valley. There's always a concert that I'm trying to attend, sometimes I show up in the hotel/club and I'm late for the concert, or I'm too early. Big bar in the middle of the club, fountains etc., lots of guests. Usually get bored and search out the mall, but there's only one store I go into, and it's my favorite store. Comics, lots of comics, rare editions of things that don't even exist, toys, weird collector shit. I never open them. Usually something distracts me and it's time to go, or for some reason I'm fumbling and misplacing things before actually getting to pay for them or keep anything. Sometimes I'm in a huge crooked hotel, lots of weird staircases and things you would never want to climb on, if you walk outside of the hotel usually there's some sort of crisis or panic in the streets going on and people are scrambling, white tables outside the hotel. There's also a rural section of town you can drive to, houses are all run-down looking and the neighborhood is usually dangerous, the houses also don't have fences so you can see for long stretches in-between them...if you're being chased. These dreams happen several times a week. I really like that store btw.
